scientific_meaning: From the cloud export alone the time shares and the screened ambient of a drive can be rebuilt within the R1 limits; distance (aggregate bias -6.3 %, interval -10.4 to -2.9; shortest tercile -25 %) and duration (-12 %) cannot. The 331 strict unlogged units (cloud total 1,918 km, lower-biased) contain more time below 30 km/h and less above 80 km/h than the cloud-reconstructed logged drives; this is a selection difference that follows their short length, not an effect.
